Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:

  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

LIGHT=(240,217,181); DARK=(181,136,99)

from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/app/chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
LIGHT=(240,217,181); DARK=(181,136,99)
files='abcdefgh'; rows='87654321'
data=img.load()
def isbg(p):
    R,G,B=p
    return (abs(R-LIGHT[0])<35 and abs(G-LIGHT[1])<35 and abs(B-LIGHT[2])<35) or \
           (abs(R-DARK[0])<35 and abs(G-DARK[1])<35 and abs(B-DARK[2])<35)
def rawmask(name):
    col=files.index(name[0]); row=rows.index(name[1])
    x0,y0=col*80,row*80
    m=[[0]*80 for _ in range(80)]
    for y in range(80):
        for x in range(80):
            if not isbg(data[x0+x,y0+y]): m[y][x]=1
    return m
def centered(mask, size=44):
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(80) for x in range(80) if mask[y][x]]
    if not pts: return None
    xs=[p[1] for p in pts]; ys=[p[0] for p in pts]
    cx=sum(xs)/len(xs); cy=sum(ys)/len(ys)
    h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
    s=size/max(h,w)
    out=[[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
    for y,x in pts:
        # map to centered grid
        nx=round((x-cx)*s + size/2); ny=round((y-cy)*s + size/2)
        if 0<=nx<size and 0<=ny<size: out[ny][nx]=1
    return out
black={'pawn':'b7','knight':'f5','bishop':'c6','rook':'a8','queen':'c8','king':'d8'}
tmpl={k:centered(rawmask(v)) for k,v in black.items()}
whites=['e5','h5','a3','c3','b2','e2','f2','g2','a1','c1','e1','h1']
white={w:centered(rawmask(w)) for w in whites}
def iou(a,b):
    i=u=0
    for y in range(44):
        for x in range(44):
            if a[y][x] or b[y][x]: u+=1
            if a[y][x] and b[y][x]: i+=1
    return i/u if u else 0
print(f'{"sq":4} ' + ' '.join(f'{k:7}' for k in black))
print(f'{"sq":4} {'best:7}  all scores')
for w in whites:
    scores={k:iou(white[w],tmpl[k]) for k in black}
    best=max(scores,key=scores.get)
    detail=' '.join(f'{k[:3]}={scores[k]:.2f}' for k in black)

from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/app/chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
files='abcdefgh'; rows='87654321'
data=img.load()
def iswhite(p):  # pure white piece fill
    return min(p)>240
def isblack(p):  # dark piece fill
    return max(p)<130
raw_black={'pawn':'b7','knight':'f5','bishop':'c6','rook':'a8','queen':'c8','king':'d8'}
whites=['e5','h5','a3','c3','b2','e2','f2','g2','a1','c1','e1','h1']
def mask_for(name):
    col=files.index(name[0]); row=rows.index(name[1])
    x0,y0=col*80,row*80
    m=[[0]*80 for _ in range(80)]
    for y in range(80):
        for x in range(80):
            p=data[x0+x,y0+y]
            if iswhite(p) or isblack(p): m[y][x]=1
    return m
def centered(mask, size=48):
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(80) for x in range(80) if mask[y][x]]
    xs=[p[1] for p in pts]; ys=[p[0] for p in pts]
    cx=sum(xs)/len(xs); cy=sum(ys)/len(ys)
    h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
    s=size/max(h,w)
    out=[[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
    for y,x in pts:
        nx=round((x-cx)*s + size/2); ny=round((y-cy)*s + size/2)
        if 0<=nx<size and 0<=ny<size: out[ny][nx]=1
    return out
tmpl={k:centered(mask_for(v)) for k,v in raw_black.items()}
white={w:centered(mask_for(w)) for w in whites}
def iou(a,b):
    i=u=0
    for y in range(48):
        for x in range(48):
            if a[y][x] or b[y][x]: u+=1
            if a[y][x] and b[y][x]: i+=1
    return i/u if u else 0
print('sq   ' + '  '.join(k[:3].rjust(6) for k in raw_black) + '   best')
for w in whites:
    scores={k:iou(white[w],tmpl[k]) for k in raw_black}
    best=max(scores,key=scores.get)
    detail='  '.join(('%5.2f'%scores[k]) for k in raw_black)
    print(w.ljust(5) + detail + '   ' + best)
PYEOF

from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/app/chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
files='abcdefgh'; rows='87654321'
data=img.load()
def piecepx(p): return min(p)>240 or max(p)<130
def getpts(name):
    col=files.index(name[0]); row=rows.index(name[1])
    x0,y0=col*80,row*80
    pts=set()
    for y in range(80):
        for x in range(80):
            if piecepx(data[x0+x,y0+y]): pts.add((x,y))
    return pts
def centroid(pts):
    xs=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts); ys=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
    return xs,ys
def aligned_diff(p1,p2, search=4):
    c1=centroid(p1); c2=centroid(p2)
    best=1e9
    # shift p2 by (dx,dy); we want p1 shifted to overlap p2
    # compute diff for each integer shift around centroid difference
    ox=round(c1[0]-c2[0]); oy=round(c1[1]-c2[1])
    for dx in range(-search,search+1):
        for dy in range(-search,search+1):
            s2={(x+ox+dx,y+oy+dy) for x,y in p2}
            inter=len(p1 & s2); uni=len(p1 | s2)
            d=1-inter/uni if uni else 1
            if d<best: best=d
    return best
# reference types with known identities (verified by eye)
templates={
 'pawn(b7)':getpts('b7'),
 'knight(f5)':getpts('f5'),
 'bishop(c6)':getpts('c6'),
 'rook(a8)':getpts('a8'),
 'queen(c8)':getpts('c8'),
 'king(d8)':getpts('d8'),
}

unknowns=sorted(set(unknowns))
for u in ['g5','e2','c1','c8','d8','a8','f8','h1','a1','c6','d5','b7','f5']:
    p=getpts(u)
    res=sorted(((aligned_diff(p,t),k) for k,t in templates.items()))
    top=res[:3]
    print(f'{u}: ' + '  '.join(f'{k}={d:.3f}' for d,k in top))

import chess, chess.engine
FEN='r1qk1r2/1p3pp1/p1b1p3/3bPnqP/8/P1B5/1P2QPP1/R1K1N2R w - - 0 1'
board=chess.Board(FEN)
eng=chess.engine.SimpleEngine.popen_uci('stockfish')
eng.configure({'Threads':4,'Hash':128})
print('Stockfish:', eng.id()['name'])
print('Root eval (White to move, in check):')
res=eng.analyse(board,chess.engine.Limit(depth=30,movetime=15000))
print('  score(white):', res['score'].white(), ' depth:', res['depth'], ' pv:', ' '.join(board.san(m) for m in res['pv'])[:120])
print()
print('Evaluating each legal check-response (White perspective after move):')
results=[]
for m in board.legal_moves:
    b2=board.copy()
    san=b2.san(m)
    b2.push(m)
    r=eng.analyse(b2,chess.engine.Limit(depth=30,movetime=12000))
    # score from white's perspective: b2 is black to move, so score.white()
    sc=r['score'].white()
    mv = f'{chess.square_name(m.from_square)}{chess.square_name(m.to_square)}'
    results.append((sc, mv, san, r['depth'], r['pv']))
    print(f'  {mv} ({san}): score.white={sc} depth={r["depth"]} pv={" ".join(b2.san(x) for x in r["pv"])[:100]}')
eng.stop()
results.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0].white() if x[0] is not None else -10000), reverse=True)
print()
print('Sorted by White evaluation (best first):')
for sc,mv,san,d,pv in results:
    print(f'  {sc}  {mv} {san}')
